name: certificate-generator
description: A generic, self-serve certificate tool built on Google Sheets + Apps Script. Deployers upload a design, positions are set visually, participants validate with email+code and render/download their own certificate client-side - nothing is generated or stored server-side.

scripts.push:bound: npm run build:bound && cd build/bound && clasp push
scripts.push:standalone: npm run build:standalone && cd build/standalone && clasp push
